method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, the rules in one module and the claimant's questions in a seat module importing it; one regulative rule (the time bar) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation of Actions Act 1974 (Qld), Act No. 75 of 1974, the version in force from 2026-04-28 (current on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1974-075.txt (text sha256 6775c3661a5cae95470915797eb947960fc27b331a4222733de88f7ac087d116), retrieved from legislation.qld.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the claimant: the individual to whom a right of action accrues and who brings or proposes to bring the action (injured person, family member or personal representative suing for a death or for the estate, survivor of child abuse, person with a dust-related condition, person defamed, party to a contract or deed, creditor, beneficiary of a trust or estate, person who paid a tax under an invalid law) (qla-seat.l4); the s 40 and s 42 questions are asked by the same individual when answering a claim

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run qla-dates.l4 ; l4 run qla-rules.l4 ; l4 run qla-seat.l4 ; l4 run qla-cases.l4

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
